name: Python Universal v1.0
author: consolex1@consolex1.com
description: Universal Python egg. Automatic venv, dependency install via uv (requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, uv.lock).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /mnt/server

echo "========================================"
echo " Python Universal Installer v1.0"
echo "========================================"
echo ""
echo "[Python] Python: $(python --version 2>&1)"
echo "[Python] pip: $(pip --version | awk '{print $2}')"

if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
    echo "[Python] requirements.txt detected (installed at startup)."
elif [ -f uv.lock ]; then
    echo "[Python] uv.lock detected (installed at startup)."
elif [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
    echo "[Python] pyproject.toml detected (installed at startup)."
else
    echo "[Python] No dependencies file found."
fi

echo ""
echo "[Python] Installation completed."

variables.name: Python File
variables.description: Main file to run (e.g. main.py, app.py, bot.py).

variables.name: Extra Arguments
variables.description: Optional arguments appended to the startup command.

variables.name: Additional Packages
variables.description: Extra pip packages, space-separated (e.g. discord.py aiohttp).
